resources.string: Each lecture is a cinematic classroom whiteboard. English writes on the board, diagrams draw, and the teacher explains in Urdish. Tap listen.
Board English میں write ہوتا ہے، diagrams draw ہوتے ہیں — explanation Urdish میں سنو۔
Open a chapter, then a lecture. Watch the English board write; listen in Urdish.
Install Google Urdu TTS if the Urdish lecture voice does not start
